subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual team building event will be taking place on Friday, September 10th at the local park. The day will be filled with fun activities, team challenges, and a delicious BBQ lunch. Please mark your calendars and plan to join us for a day of team bonding and relaxation. More details will be shared closer to the date. We look forward to seeing everyone there! Best regards, [Your Company's Name]
